summary: Prime Minister Netanyahu discussed renewing strikes on Iran with former President Trump ahead of Israeli elections, while Saudi Arabia intercepted Houthi ballistic missiles and drones targeting Riyadh and southern regions. Israeli Defense Minister Katz signed a six-month ban on fiber-optic and cellular-guided drones in Israeli airspace citing concrete intelligence threats. Meanwhile, artillery shelling continued across southern Lebanon and Houthi forces announced attacks on Saudi Aramco facilities.
key_points: Netanyahu spoke with Trump last week about resuming attacks on Iran before Israeli elections, though no final decision was made (Source: @yediotnews25/136206).
Saudi-led coalition intercepted and destroyed a Houthi ballistic missile fired toward Haradh (Source: @shin_persian/11083).

Houthi-aligned media announced ballistic missile attacks targeting Aramco headquarters in Dammam, King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, and Aramco's Riyadh refinery (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8273).
Saudi Arabia intercepted two drones over Riyadh and the southern region (Source: @N12chat/229910).
Israeli Heron TP drone detected heading toward Lebanon with estimated 25-minute arrival at border (Source: @redlinkleb/47858).
Defense Minister Katz signed a special security order banning fiber-optic and SIM-guided drones in Israeli airspace for six months (Source: @manniefabian/59350).

Artillery shelling reported in Wadi al-Hujeir, Haddatha, Haris, Meidoun, and Mazar'at Buyut al-Siyad in southern Lebanon (Source: @redlinkleb/47887, @redlinkleb/47869, @redlinkleb/47882, @redlinkleb/47874).
MI5 warned Iran is targeting Jewish communities in the UK with over 50 arrests in the past year for Iran-linked terror plots (Source: @yediotnews25/136198).

sections.executive_summary: Prime Minister Netanyahu discussed renewing strikes on Iran with former President Trump ahead of Israeli elections, while Saudi Arabia intercepted Houthi ballistic missiles and drones targeting Riyadh and southern regions. Israeli Defense Minister Katz signed a six-month ban on fiber-optic and cellular-guided drones in Israeli airspace citing concrete intelligence threats. Meanwhile, artillery shelling continued across southern Lebanon and Houthi forces announced attacks on Saudi Aramco facilities.

points: UAV activity detected over the Iranian-Iraqi border in West Azerbaijan Province at 20:58 local time, prompting Faraja personnel to be placed on high alert and prepared for site evacuations (Source: @shin_persian/11081, @shin_persian/11078).

UK domestic intelligence agency MI5 warned that Iran is targeting Jewish communities in Britain, with more than 50 people arrested in the past year for suspected involvement in Iran-linked terror plots (Source: @yediotnews25/136198).

Defense Minister Katz stated that Israel identifies attempts by enemies, led by Iran and its proxies, to advance attacks that could influence Israeli election outcomes, warning that any attacker will pay the heaviest price (Source: @amitsegal/65757).

Netanyahu reportedly spoke with former President Trump last week about the possibility of renewing strikes against Iran before Israeli elections, though no final decision has been made (Source: @yediotnews25/136206).

Defense Minister Israel Katz signed a special security order banning the use of fiber-optic cable-guided and cellular-guided drones in Israeli airspace for six months, citing concrete intelligence and growing threats from enemies inside and outside the country (Source: @manniefabian/59350).
A vehicle attempted to breach the perimeter of Ramon Airport but was stopped without shots fired; the vehicle reportedly overturned and crashed into the base fence (Source: @yediotnews25/136199).

Reservist organizations demanded the next government expand the IDF, reporting that 47% of reservists have served over 150 days since October 2023, 20% over 300 days, and 1,080 complaints filed for dismissal due to reserve duty (Source: @yediotnews25/136210).
Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir emphasized the obligation to broaden recruitment ranks, addressing the need for a larger military force (Source: @yediotnews25/136208).
An Israeli Heron TP drone was tracked heading toward Lebanon with an estimated 25 minutes to reach the Lebanese border (Source: @redlinkleb/47858).

Naftali Bennett responded to Netanyahu's remarks about preparing for a 'flipping scenario' in Judea and Samaria, criticizing the prime minister for only warning about problems rather than fixing them (Source: @yediotnews25/136204).

Artillery shelling reported in Wadi al-Hujeir (Source: @redlinkleb/47887, @redlinkleb/47888), Haddatha and Haris (Source: @redlinkleb/47869), Meidoun where enemy dropped flares simultaneously with artillery fire (Source: @redlinkleb/47882), and Mazar'at Buyut al-Siyad (Source: @redlinkleb/47874).

Real-time mapping shows red circles indicating areas affected by hostile drone activity in Lebanese airspace, with the number of circles representing affected areas not drone count (Source: @redlinkleb/47866).
Israeli Heron TP drone detected en route to Lebanon with approximately 25 minutes until border crossing (Source: @redlinkleb/47858).

UAV activity observed over the Iranian-Iraqi border in West Azerbaijan Province, Iran, at 20:58 local time (1728Z), with Iranian Faraja forces placed on high alert and prepared for evacuations (Source: @shin_persian/11081, @shin_persian/11078).
Saudi-led coalition intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by Houthi militia toward Haradh (Source: @shin_persian/11083).
Saudi Arabia intercepted two drones over Riyadh and the southern region (Source: @N12chat/229910).

Houthi-aligned media announced ballistic missile attacks targeting Aramco headquarters in Dammam, King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, and Aramco's Riyadh refinery, warning all Aramco facilities are now targets (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8273, @Faytuks_Network/8269).

Saudi-led coalition issued evacuation warnings for civilians around Al-Sabah Central Station in Sana'a ahead of imminent strikes by the Royal Saudi Air Force on an oil installation, in response to recent attacks on King Khalid International Airport (Source: @shin_persian/11070, @Faytuks_Network/8267).
Houthi forces reportedly secured the western gate of Taiz city (Source: @shin_persian/11075).
UN reported a 10% increase in wheat flour prices in recent weeks in Yemen's besieged city of Taiz, with overall rises of 40-50% as local activity intensified (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8280).

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous escalation on multiple fronts indicates a coordinated pressure campaign. Iran's potential direct involvement via renewed Israeli strikes, coupled with Houthi missile and drone attacks on Saudi strategic energy infrastructure, suggests a regional escalation ladder being tested. Israel's preemptive drone ban reflects acute concern over precision-guided UAV threats targeting senior officials and critical infrastructure. The convergence of election politics in Israel with military decision-making adds unpredictability to deterrence calculations.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia is conducting retaliatory strikes on Houthi targets in Sana'a while maintaining air defense readiness. The Saudi-led coalition's evacuation warnings demonstrate an effort to limit civilian casualties while projecting force. Iran's proxy network appears activated across Yemen, Lebanon, and potentially Iraq, with UAV activity on the Iranian-Iraqi border signaling heightened readiness. The UK's public attribution of Iran-linked terror plots indicates growing Western intelligence alignment on Iranian external operations.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Heron TP drone transit to Lebanon suggests ongoing Israeli ISR operations over Hezbollah positions. The specific ban on fiber-optic and cellular-guided drones implies Israeli intelligence has identified these guidance systems as the primary threat vector for precision attacks. Houthi target lists focusing exclusively on Aramco facilities indicate a strategic shift toward economic warfare. The 120-second delayed reporting from Iranian border sensors suggests operational security measures by Iranian monitoring networks.
